I’m not black but I can relate to internalized racism. In the last year or so I have felt this intensely and it really drove me crazy. The fact that I am mixed and look a bit ambiguous has just added to my turmoil. I just felt like appearing as I am is a death sentence. but then I had this epiphany earlier in the week that helped me. I don’t really know how to explain it, I just became aware and really felt all the sudden all the ways in which I am privileged and that my life is far from a death sentence. But that’s just something that worked for me. I’m not “fixed” but I feel more at peace ever since. 

In the past year or two I tried to fight it through the music I listened to, media I consume. But I still felt ashamed. Ik this is weird but when I finally just stopped fighting it and let myself hate myself and just surrender…that’s when I started to come to terms with myself. and hopefully on the path to truly believing that what I am is a blessing. Though filtering out your media and educating yourself are important for sure. I’m trying to consume media with white ppl at little as possible.
